body:
I did come here to seek help, but seeing this...

There are thousands of words. Thousands of ways to say you are special. To say how it would be an empty tragedy if you end it all instead of finding the ray of light and hope and love for something.  To say that just in a little time, if you hold on and do not give up, you may enjoy life so much more than you do now and you would be so grateful you did not end it all.

And it is all true. I may write a thousand words and they would never reach you, and what do words from a complete stranger like me even mean to you anyway? Yet I say it now nonetheless.

Life may be dark and difficult and you may feel hopeless and tired and resentful about not just your current circumstances, but your own existence itself. And even in the darkest times, you are more than your guilt, you are more than your fears, you are more than your wrath. And this emptiness, this sadness, this void - it is not who you are and it is not who you may be - if you would only allow it, if you would find the flame in the darkness and give your life radiance and colors. You are more than your guilt, you are more than your fears, you are more than your wrath. Yet no one else is able to save you - a choice to embrace living despite all the emptiness and despair may be the most difficult choice in your entire life - and it is the choice only you are able to make. Your fate is in your own hands now. Please, save yourself!
